initial_finding.summary: Physical-return finalization originally accepted generic H17 1,1 state without proving that enable, latch, and evidence-run belonged to the current journal intent.
initial_finding.closure: The finalizer now reads only the exact enable, latch, and evidence-run identities; requires one shared 64-hex intent; compares all three exact expected byte hashes to the current record-1 SHA256; and performs this proof before crash-prefix reconstruction or final health.

validated_properties: exact H16 installed predecessor boot and execution closure
H17 A/B receipt binds observer public key, firstboot, native closure, and compiled v5 binding
F1 transfers only one exact boot candidate or the exact V2321 boot rollback
fresh retired-trial F1 and D1 approvals do not derive authority from qualification
one attended combined arm-plus-reboot dispatch with no replay
persistent Debian PASS remains HEALTH_PENDING_PERSISTENT_DEBIAN and leaves the ordinal open
no-effect cancellation requires the same-intent post-fsync record
physical-return closure sends no reboot and requires exact same-intent enable, latch, and evidence-run bytes
closed resident health satisfies the inter-effect barrier but grants no new device-effect authority
A90-only target, rollback, recovery, private evidence, and S22+ isolation
